coupling: The first edit records the matching numeric class identifier in same_type while preserving the existing whole-array copy behavior. The later slab-indexing commit treats that identifier as permission to bulk-copy a leading uint8 column subset. Its memcpy still uses the full variable nbytes, so a caller-sized subset buffer overflows. Either edit alone keeps the full-array restriction effective; repairing the combined path requires matching the fast-path eligibility to the selected byte count and the class-tag meaning established earlier.
